title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Halls Gap, 6–8 November, 2015–2025
claims: For Halls Gap on 6–8 November in 2015–2025 there are 33 daily records: daily maximum 12.1–28.9 °C (median 19.7 °C), daily minimum 5.0–14.0 °C (median 9.2 °C), 10 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 3 days with at least 5 mm.
The grid is Halls Gap village, not Mt William, Durd Durd, Jimmy Creek or Dunkeld.

verification.note: Daily values retrieved and filtered to 6–8 November; medians and wet-day counts calculated locally.
